```{r news, echo=FALSE}
# Builds one section per entry in `sections`, with one card per news item,
# then the Openings section from the `openings` list.
library(htmltools)

news <- rmarkdown::metadata$news

# Newest first, whatever order the items are written in: "Nov 2026" is turned
# into a number (year * 12 + month). Items with the same month keep their order.
month_key <- function(d) {
  parts <- strsplit(trimws(d), " +")[[1]]
  key <- as.integer(parts[2]) * 12 + match(tolower(substr(parts[1], 1, 3)), tolower(month.abb))
  if (is.na(key)) stop("News date not understood (use e.g. \"Nov 2026\"): ", d)
  key
}
news <- news[order(-vapply(news, function(n) month_key(n$date), numeric(1)))]

# one image at a time, with buttons to move between them if there are several
photo_gallery <- function(photos, is_figure = FALSE, focus = NULL, is_portrait = FALSE) {
  div(class = paste("news-figure news-photos", if (is_figure) "is-figure", if (is_portrait) "is-portrait"),
      style = paste0(if (!is.null(focus)) paste0("--focus:", focus, ";"),
                     if (is_portrait) paste0("--bg:url('", photos[[1]]$src, "');")),
      Map(function(p, i) {
        a(href = p$src, target = "_blank", hidden = if (i > 1) NA,
          img(src = p$src, alt = p$alt, loading = "lazy"))
      }, photos, seq_along(photos)),
      if (length(photos) > 1)
        div(class = "news-photo-nav",
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-prev", `aria-label` = "Previous image",
                        tags$i(class = "bi bi-chevron-left", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
            span(class = "news-count", `aria-live` = "polite", paste0("1 / ", length(photos))),
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-next", `aria-label` = "Next image",
                        tags$i(class = "bi bi-chevron-right", `aria-hidden` = "true"))))
}

# Paper figures are shown whole (their licence may not allow cropping, and their
# text would be cut): every item in the Publications tab, and any item with `fit: figure`.
# All other photos are cropped to the wide box; `focus: "50% 20%"` moves the crop.
# `fit: portrait` shows a tall photo whole, centred on a blurred copy of itself.
is_figure <- function(n) identical(n$category, "Publications") || identical(n$fit, "figure")

# an item with no photo gets the lab logo in a box of the same size
no_photo <- function(is_figure = FALSE) {
  div(class = paste("news-figure is-empty", if (is_figure) "is-figure"),
      img(src = "images/logobraindev.png", alt = "", loading = "lazy"))
}

card <- function(n) {
  tags$article(
    class = "news-card",
    if (length(n$photos) > 0) photo_gallery(n$photos, is_figure(n), n$focus, identical(n$fit, "portrait")) else no_photo(is_figure(n)),
    div(class = "news-body",
        if (!is.null(n$credit)) div(class = "news-credit", n$credit),
        div(class = "news-meta", n$date),
        h3(class = "news-title", n$title),
        tags$p(class = "news-text", n$text),
        if (!is.null(n$link))
          a(class = "news-link", href = n$link, target = "_blank", n$link_text)))
}

# one panel per subtab; the id also lets a link open it, e.g. news.html#openings
panel_id <- function(heading) gsub("[^a-z]+", "-", tolower(heading))

tab_button <- function(heading, first) {
  tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-filter",
              `data-panel` = panel_id(heading), `aria-controls` = panel_id(heading),
              `aria-pressed` = if (first) "true" else "false", heading)
}

panel <- function(heading, first, ...) {
  tags$section(class = "news-section", id = panel_id(heading),
               `aria-label` = heading, hidden = if (!first) NA, ...)
}

news_panel <- function(s, first) {
  items <- Filter(function(n) identical(n$category, s$category), news)
  panel(s$heading, first, div(class = "news-grid", lapply(items, card)))
}

# --- Openings ---
openings <- rmarkdown::metadata$openings
nice_date <- function(d) format(as.Date(d), "%d %B %Y")

fact <- function(label, value) {
  if (is.null(value)) return(NULL)
  tagList(tags$dt(label), tags$dd(value))
}

# past positions get a "Closed" tag and a grey edge; the button stays the same
opening_card <- function(o) {
  past <- as.Date(o$deadline) < Sys.Date()
  tags$article(
    class = paste("opening-card", if (past) "is-past"),
    `data-deadline` = as.character(o$deadline),
    span(class = "opening-closed", "Closed"),
    h3(class = "opening-title", o$title),
    tags$dl(class = "opening-facts",
            fact("Position", o$type),
            fact("Location", o$location),
            fact("Start", o$start),
            fact("Apply by", nice_date(o$deadline)),
            fact("Reference", o$reference),
            fact("Contact", o$contact)),
    tags$p(class = "opening-text", o$summary),
    a(class = "opening-link", href = o$link, target = "_blank",
      "Read more and apply"))
}

sections <- rmarkdown::metadata$sections
headings <- c(vapply(sections, function(s) s$heading, ""), "Openings")
first <- seq_along(headings) == 1

tagList(
  div(class = "news-filters", role = "group", `aria-label` = "News sections",
      Map(tab_button, headings, first)),
  Map(news_panel, sections, first[seq_along(sections)]),
  panel("Openings", FALSE,
    tags$p(class = "opening-intro", "Positions in the DeMON Lab are advertised through Lund University. ",
           "Have a question, or no position that fits? Get in touch through the ",
           a(href = "takepart.html", "Contact"), " page."),
    div(class = "opening-list", lapply(openings, opening_card)))
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Mark positions as closed in the visitor's browser the day after their
// deadline, since the site is only rebuilt now and then.
(function () {
  var d = new Date();
  var today = d.getFullYear() + "-" +
    String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" +
    String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  document.querySelectorAll(".opening-card").forEach(function (card) {
    if (card.dataset.deadline < today) card.classList.add("is-past");
  });
})();

// Subtabs: show only the chosen section. A link to news.html#openings (or any
// other section id) opens that section directly.
(function () {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".news-filter");
  function show(id) {
    var found = false;
    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
      var on = b.dataset.panel === id;
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on);
      document.getElementById(b.dataset.panel).hidden = !on;
      found = found || on;
    });
    return found;
  }
  buttons.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      show(b.dataset.panel);
      history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + b.dataset.panel);
    });
  });
  if (location.hash) show(location.hash.slice(1));
})();

(function () {
  // Image buttons: move through a card's images, starting again after the last.
  document.querySelectorAll(".news-photos").forEach(function (box) {
    var photos = box.querySelectorAll("a");
    var count = box.querySelector(".news-count");
    var current = 0;
    function move(step) {
      current = (current + step + photos.length) % photos.length;
      photos.forEach(function (p, k) { p.hidden = k !== current; });
      count.textContent = (current + 1) + " / " + photos.length;
    }
    if (!count) return;
    box.querySelector(".news-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { move(-1); });
    box.querySelector(".news-next").addEventListener("click", function () { move(1); });
  });
})();
</script>
```
